body: Modules require each other at v0.0.0-00010101000000-000000000000 and go.work maps each zero version to its directory with a workspace replace. Plain 'use' alone failed (go resolved github.com/ubgo/textdata@zero through the proxy once a module with third-party requirements joined the workspace). go.mod files carry no replace, so 'go install ...@version' keeps working after release; the release step pins real versions, base first, and tidies each module.
title: Unreleased sibling modules resolve through go.work replace directives
